plainFields.description: IP address during member registration.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp the member joined the platform.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last member data update.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp if member deletes/leaves platform.

models.name: political_economic_board_moderators
models.description: Elevated user accounts with moderation privileges. Linked to members (one-to-one, as only members may be promoted). Maintains activation/deactivation timestamps, moderator notes, and event status. Permanent audit trail required for promotion/demotion actions (see political_economic_board_role_changes).

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: activated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp moderator privileges were granted.

plainFields.name: deactivated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp moderator role revoked or expired, if applicable.

plainFields.name: moderator_notes
plainFields.description: Freeform notes on moderation appointment, limits, or context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp moderator record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp moderator record last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for former moderator accounts.

models.name: political_economic_board_administrators
models.description: Highest privilege user accounts for site governance, role assignments, escalations, and config changes. Linked to members (one-to-one, as only members may be promoted). Full auditability and clear role separation are essential. Distinguished from moderators by administrator status/level. Action history recorded separately (see political_economic_board_role_changes and logs).

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: activated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp administrator privileges were granted.

plainFields.name: deactivated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp administrator role revoked or expired, if applicable.

plainFields.name: admin_notes
plainFields.description: Administrative comments or rationale for specific privileges, if any.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp administrator record created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp administrator record updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp for administrator account (if downgraded or deleted).

models.name: political_economic_board_auth_sessions
models.description: Tracks all authenticated user sessions for members, moderators, and administrators. Includes JWT/refresh tokens, device info, session expiry, IP, and audit. Used for security, MFA, and suspicious activity detection. Each row represents one authentication session; session ending triggers record update to reflect closure.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Session's owner member {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: session_token
plainFields.description: JWT/access token for current session (opaque storage, not user credentials).

plainFields.name: refresh_token
plainFields.description: Refresh token for session lifecycle management.

plainFields.name: device_info
plainFields.description: Details on device/browser used in the session.

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address associated with this session.

plainFields.name: session_expires_at
plainFields.description: Expiration timestamp for session token.

plainFields.name: revoked_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when session was terminated/revoked, if any.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp session created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp session last updated or extended.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete for session history retention, if expired/terminated.

models.name: political_economic_board_verification_tokens
models.description: Email verification and secondary auth challenge table. Each token is unique, time-bound, and belongs to a member. Supports registration verification, password resets, and email challenge flows for MFA. Tokens record purpose, target, and creation/expiry audit fields.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Verification token's owner member {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Opaque random string representing the verification token value.

plainFields.name: token_type
plainFields.description: Purpose of token: e.g., email_verification, reset_password, mfa.

plainFields.name: context
plainFields.description: Additional context for this token, e.g., origin email, device, or request meta.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp after which token is invalid.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the token was used (if applicable).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp last updated (e.g., reissued/rotated).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete if token invalidated or removed before expiry.

models.name: political_economic_board_password_resets
models.description: Manages all password reset flows and history. Stores reset tokens, request/fulfillment audit data, and intent context. Token must be unique per reset. Used by backend flows for secure user-initiated password changes and automated lockout recovery. Security: sensitive context must be purged after fulfillment or expiry.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Owner member who initiated password reset {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: reset_token
plainFields.description: Random unique token for password reset authentication.

plainFields.name: request_ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which reset was requested.

plainFields.name: fulfilled_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp request was completed (password was changed).

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp reset token becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp reset request created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp reset record last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp, if record removed.

models.name: political_economic_board_role_changes
models.description: Audit table for all user role changes: log upgrades, demotions, suspensions, reactivations, with rationale and actor chain. Each event references a member, previous and new role, trigger origin (admin/mod/system), and event context. This is the authoritative ledger for permissions history and compliance tracing. Immutable except for soft delete. Used for platform audits and compliance, but never modifies role status; that is managed by role-specific tables.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Target member for this role change log entry {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: old_role
plainFields.description: Previous role before change (guest, member, moderator, administrator).

plainFields.name: new_role
plainFields.description: New role after change (same value set as old_role).

plainFields.name: context
plainFields.description: Freeform context for the change: reason, policy citation, compliance reference, etc.

plainFields.name: triggered_by_actor_type
plainFields.description: Type of actor who initiated change (system, moderator, administrator).

plainFields.name: triggered_by_actor_id
plainFields.description: Actor's ID (admin/mod/system id) responsible for change.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Rationale or justification provided by triggering actor.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp role change was logged.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp role change record last updated (for audit sync).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete audit for compliance (never physical delete).

models.name: political_economic_board_profiles
models.description: Stores public profile data for each member, distinct from authentication or role tables. Includes display name, bio, profile photo, join date, and privacy settings. Each profile is linked to a single member entity in political_economic_board_members, and may have multiple associated badges and statistics. Designed for frequent updates and privacy-driven data management.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Linked member entity's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. One-to-one relationship, ensures every profile belongs to one member.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Public name visible to other users. 1-50 characters, must be unique across active profiles.

plainFields.name: bio
plainFields.description: Profile biography or summary, up to 500 characters. Optional.

plainFields.name: profile_photo_url
plainFields.description: URL to uploaded profile photo (JPG/PNG, max 2MB). Optional.

plainFields.name: join_date
plainFields.description: Date profile was first created or linked to a member. For analytics and display.

plainFields.name: privacy_level
plainFields.description: Profile privacy setting (e.g., 'public', 'members_only', 'private'). Business logic in API layer enforces allowed values.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when profile was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when profile was last updated (any non-deleted field).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Nullable timestamp for soft deletes.

models.name: political_economic_board_profile_badges
models.description: Tracks awarded badges or achievements to individual profiles, representing user reputation, contributions, or recognition (e.g., 'founding member', 'top contributor'). Multiple badges can be assigned per profile, each with type, issue date, optional expiration, and unique badge code per profile. Enables flexible badge expansion and business logic enforcement on award frequency and scope.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Target profile's {@link political_economic_board_profiles.id} receiving this badge.

plainFields.name: badge_code
plainFields.description: Unique code or slug representing badge type. E.g., 'founding_member', 'top_contributor'.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Display title for badge ('Founding Member', etc.).

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Longer description of the badge's meaning or achievement. Optional.

plainFields.name: issued_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when badge was granted to the profile.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Nullable timestamp for expiration for time-limited awards.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp row was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last badge update.

models.name: political_economic_board_profile_stats
models.description: Maintains aggregate, de-identified activity metrics for each profile (posts, comments, votes, reactions, earned badges, and reputation score). Allows fast retrieval of user stats and supports periodic recalculation by business logic. Data is aggregate, not individual events, and can be reset or recalculated. Profile stats are used in profile displays, leaderboards, and eligibility checks for advanced features or moderation.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Profile being summarized. Foreign key to {@link political_economic_board_profiles.id}.

plainFields.name: posts_count
plainFields.description: Total number of non-deleted posts authored by this profile.

plainFields.name: comments_count
plainFields.description: Total number of comments authored by this profile.

plainFields.name: votes_cast_count
plainFields.description: Total number of upvotes/downvotes cast by this user.

plainFields.name: reactions_cast_count
plainFields.description: Total number of emoji reactions performed by this user.

plainFields.name: badges_earned_count
plainFields.description: Current unique badges awarded to this profile.

plainFields.name: reputation_score
plainFields.description: Current reputation tally, according to voting/achievement rules.

plainFields.name: last_calculated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp stats were last updated or recalculated to reflect new activity.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Row creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Row update timestamp.

models.name: political_economic_board_profile_changes
models.description: Stores snapshots and audit logs of all profile changes (display name, bio, privacy, etc.), providing a temporal historical record for transparency, rollback, and compliance. Each row reflects an individual change event, referencing the affected profile and authoring user, with field changed, old and new values, timestamp, and rationale. Allows administrators or audit tools to reconstruct profile history and support dispute resolution or compliance requirements.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_profile_id
foreignFields.description: Profile changed. References {@link political_economic_board_profiles.id}.

foreignFields.name: change_author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Account responsible for this profile change. {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

plainFields.name: change_field
plainFields.description: The profile field updated (e.g., 'display_name', 'bio', 'privacy_level').

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: Previous value before change occurred, for audit trail. Optional (may be null if no previous value).

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: New value after the update. Optional, may be null for deletions.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Reason or justification for the profile change. May be entered by user or generated by system.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of when this change was processed/applied.

models.name: political_economic_board_posts
models.description: Represents the main discussion post entities on the platform. Each record captures an authored post including title, body, category, and submitter. Enforces business rules for content quota, policy validation, and links to related content such as categories and tags. Lifecycle fields (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and author relationships support moderation, edit, and audit requirements. All foreign keys refer to already existing reference/user tables.

foreignFields.name: author_member_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. References the post author (member user account).

foreignFields.name: category_id
foreignFields.description: Belonged category's {@link political_economic_board_categories.id}. Links to the platform-defined topic category.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Post title. Must be between 10 and 100 characters, validated per business rule. Used for thread indexing and search.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Full content of the post. Range: 50–10,000 characters. Subject to policy/prohibited content screening algorithms. Indexed for search.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated (edited).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp marking when the post was soft-deleted (if applicable); null if not deleted. Supports audit, retention policies, and restore.

models.name: political_economic_board_post_histories
models.description: Snapshot/audit table recording every significant change to the main post. Preserves all relevant fields as they were at the time of modification, including author, title, body, and status for full edit/replay/audit trail. Enables moderation rollback, author dispute resolution, and supports content lifecycle legal/compliance requirements. No recalculated or derived fields; snapshot only captures raw state at change moment.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link political_economic_board_posts.id}. Connects snapshot to the corresponding main post record.

foreignFields.name: editor_member_id
foreignFields.description: Editing member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. Captures the identity of the user who performed the change (could be original author or moderator/admin).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title at the time of snapshot. Enables historical trace of changes for audit, dispute resolution, or legal recovery.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Post body content at the time of snapshot. Supports full rollback or display of previous edits.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Short code or description of the post's moderation/workflow state at the point of snapshot (e.g., 'published', 'pending', 'hidden').

plainFields.name: edited_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the snapshot/edit occurred. Indicates the moment this state became active.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: (Optional) Reason or comment describing why the change was made, as entered by the editor or generated by moderator workflow. Useful for audit/compliance.

models.name: political_economic_board_post_statuses
models.description: Represents the status and workflow stage of each post for moderation, publication, reporting, or legal archiving. Tracks current and historical state assignments (e.g., pending, published, hidden, under_review), who applied them, and when. This enables independent moderation, content lifecycle management, reporting, and rapid compliance workflows. No denormalized or recalculated data.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link political_economic_board_posts.id}. Links this status to its post.

foreignFields.name: set_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member or moderator's {@link political_economic_board_members.id} who set the status. Identifies who performed the workflow action.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Short code or workflow status for the post (e.g., 'pending', 'published', 'hidden', 'under_review'). Used to drive business state logic and moderation workflows.

plainFields.name: set_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status assignment occurred.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: (Optional) Reason for the status change. Used to provide rationale to moderators, authors, or audit/compliance review.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: (Optional) Scheduled expiry time for the status, if state is meant to revert or timeout (e.g., temporary bans, scheduled publications).

models.name: political_economic_board_comments
models.description: Business entity for platform comments attached to posts. Supports hierarchical (nested) threading up to three levels, relates to posts and members, supports moderation, reaction, and voting via external reference tables. Core for discussions, enforcing per-user quotas, edit/delete time windows, content validation, and audit requirements. Maintains relations to current status and preserves key time/event metadata. Native UUID enforced for distributed safety.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_post_id
foreignFields.description: Parent post's {@link political_economic_board_posts.id}. Required for comment association with main discussion thread.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Authoring member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. Identifies the creator of the comment. Required for audit and voting.

foreignFields.name: parent_id
foreignFields.description: Parent comment's {@link political_economic_board_comments.id}, if this is a reply (nested). Null for top-level comments.

foreignFields.name: current_status_id
foreignFields.description: Current status from {@link political_economic_board_comment_statuses.id}, indicating the lifecycle state (active, edited, deleted, pending, hidden, etc.).

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main comment body text. Required 5-1,000 chars, validated by business rules. Subject to moderation and full-text search.

plainFields.name: nesting_level
plainFields.description: Indicates depth in nested structure (0 for root, 1 for first reply, max 2 for third level). Used to enforce max nesting and optimize queries.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when comment is created. Used for ordering and business audit.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for last edit/update to comment. Used for tracking changes and edit limits.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp for logical removal, retained for retention period per audit requirements. Null unless removed.

models.name: political_economic_board_comment_histories
models.description: Audit entity capturing every historical state/change of a comment. Snapshots each version of the comment's body, status, and key relationships, linked to root comment and responsible member. Provides rollback and restoration points for moderation, dispute, and compliance audit. Required for investigation and full edit/removal traceability.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Root comment's {@link political_economic_board_comments.id}. Historical snapshot parent.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member id responsible for change (editor, author, moderator, admin, etc.). See {@link political_economic_board_members.id}.

foreignFields.name: status_id
foreignFields.description: Status at the time of change, from {@link political_economic_board_comment_statuses.id}. Historical lifecycle status for this revision.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the comment's body at this revision. Required, 5-1,000 chars. Immutable historical value.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: Reason for the change/edit, required for moderator/admin actions (e.g., 'moderation correction', 'user edit', 'auto-hide', etc.).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this historical revision is created (i.e., when the edit, deletion, or state change occurred).

models.name: political_economic_board_comment_statuses
models.description: Normalized code/label/status table for all possible comment lifecycle states. Used by comments and comment_histories for flexible, auditable state transitions (e.g., ACTIVE, EDITED, DELETED, HIDDEN, PENDING_MODERATION, etc.). Enables code-driven workflows, consistent labeling, and business rules for allowable transitions.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Machine code/enum for status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'EDITED', etc.). Unique per row, not user facing. Used in business logic and APIs.

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: User-displayable label for the comment status (e.g., 'Active', 'Edited', 'Deleted'). Used for display, notification, and UI mapping.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the status code, describing business rules, moderation action, or visibility impacts.

plainFields.name: order
plainFields.description: Sort order for UI/status sequencing. Lower numbers appear first in lists. Used for presentation sorting.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when status entry was created (for audit). Immutable after creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Time when last updated (for UI or business rule changes).

models.name: political_economic_board_post_votes
models.description: Stores all upvote/downvote actions cast by registered members on individual posts in the discussion board. Each combination of member and post can produce at most one record, preventing duplicate votes by the same user on the same post. Actions are fully auditable and reversible, supporting real-time analytics and anti-abuse mechanisms. Tightly linked to {@link political_economic_board_members} and {@link political_economic_board_posts}.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link political_economic_board_posts.id}. The post receiving a vote.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. The voting user.

plainFields.name: vote_type
plainFields.description: Vote direction; allowed values are 'upvote' or 'downvote'. Enforced at application layer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Vote creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update of this vote action (redo, undo).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; set if vote is logically removed for auditability.

models.name: political_economic_board_comment_votes
models.description: Tracks all upvote/downvote actions performed by registered members on individual comments. One vote per member per comment is enforced for integrity. Enables comment-level ranking, moderation triggers, and voting-based analytics. Closely tied to {@link political_economic_board_members} and {@link political_economic_board_comments}.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link political_economic_board_comments.id}. The comment receiving a vote.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. The voting user.

plainFields.name: vote_type
plainFields.description: Vote direction; allowed values are 'upvote' or 'downvote'. Enforced at application layer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Vote creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update of this vote action (redo, undo).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp; set if vote is logically removed for auditability.

models.name: political_economic_board_post_reactions
models.description: Records emoji-based reactions by members to posts. Each row represents a unique (member, post, reaction_type) triplet to support reaction diversity and analytics. Prevents duplicate reactions of the same type by the same member on a post. Essential for measuring engagement and surfacing popular or controversial content. Related to {@link political_economic_board_posts} and {@link political_economic_board_members}.

foreignFields.name: post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's {@link political_economic_board_posts.id}. The post receiving the reaction.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. The reacting user.

plainFields.name: reaction_type
plainFields.description: Type of emoji/reaction (e.g., 'like', 'insight', 'question'). The set of allowable values is curated at the application level.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Reaction creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last modification of this reaction action.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail.

models.name: political_economic_board_comment_reactions
models.description: Captures emoji-based reactions made by members to comments. Each unique combination of member, comment, and reaction_type is allowed once per row, supporting a broad range of reactions without duplication. Serves member engagement analytics and moderation triggers. References {@link political_economic_board_comments} and {@link political_economic_board_members}.

foreignFields.name: comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's {@link political_economic_board_comments.id}. The comment receiving the reaction.

foreignFields.name: member_id
foreignFields.description: Member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id}. The reacting user.

plainFields.name: reaction_type
plainFields.description: Type of emoji/reaction (e.g., 'like', 'insight', 'question'). Curated and enforced by the application layer.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Reaction creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update of this reaction action.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp, if logically removed.

models.name: political_economic_board_reports
models.description: Stores all user/member-initiated reports on posts or comments in the politicalEconomicBoard. This model captures the reporting user's identity, content reference (post or comment), report reason code, explanatory description, and status info (open, under_review, resolved, escalated). Each report acts as the origin point for moderation queueing and subsequent review. Relations include referencing the reporter ({@link political_economic_board_members.id}), the target content ({@link political_economic_board_posts.id} or {@link political_economic_board_comments.id}), and audit trail. Used as a canonical source of evidence for all moderation and appeal workflows.

foreignFields.name: reporter_id
foreignFields.description: Reporting member's unique identifier. {@link political_economic_board_members.id}

foreignFields.name: target_post_id
foreignFields.description: Target post's identifier if the report concerns a post. {@link political_economic_board_posts.id}

foreignFields.name: target_comment_id
foreignFields.description: Target comment's identifier if the report concerns a comment. {@link political_economic_board_comments.id}

plainFields.name: reason_code
plainFields.description: Coded reason for the report (e.g., hate_speech, misinformation, spam, harassment, off_topic). Defined by fixed business list for moderation reporting and audit compliance.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional member-provided description or justification for the report. Optional field for audit or moderator context.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current lifecycle state of the report (open, under_review, resolved, escalated, closed, etc.) for workflow management and SLA compliance.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when report was created. For audit and operational SLA purposes.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last update (status change, escalation, moderator note, etc.).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft-delete timestamp if report was removed/canceled (retained for audit purposes).

models.name: political_economic_board_moderation_queue
models.description: Tracks reports and content items actively queued for moderator review in politicalEconomicBoard. This model links each entry to the originating report ({@link political_economic_board_reports.id}), and the content item under review. It stores moderation status (pending, in_progress, escalated, decided), priority level, scheduled review timestamps, and meta relevant for queue dashboards. Ensures that no report remains unassigned and supports audit visibility for queue handling SLAs.

foreignFields.name: report_id
foreignFields.description: Report driving the queue entry. {@link political_economic_board_reports.id}

foreignFields.name: assigned_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator assigned to review the queue entry, if assigned. {@link political_economic_board_moderators.id}

plainFields.name: queue_status
plainFields.description: Current state: pending, in_progress, escalated, resolved, closed. Used for queue tracking, SLA compliance.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Priority of the item in moderation queue (higher = more urgent).

plainFields.name: scheduled_review_at
plainFields.description: When this item is scheduled for moderator attention.

plainFields.name: decided_at
plainFields.description: When final moderation action was taken. Null if undecided.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when queue entry was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last status change or moderator comment on this queue item.

models.name: political_economic_board_moderator_actions
models.description: Captures each moderator's actions/interventions with relation to reports and flagged content in politicalEconomicBoard. models.name: political_economic_board_appeals
models.description: Stores user-member-initiated appeals against moderation decisions in politicalEconomicBoard. models.name: political_economic_board_auto_hide_events

models.name: political_economic_board_notifications
models.description: Stores all per-user, system, and operational notifications generated for members. Core relationships include recipient's {@link political_economic_board_members.id} and (if triggered by system event) entity references such as post ID or comment ID. Fields capture both delivery constraints (scheduled vs sent), status (pending, delivered, failed), and support for retries or escalation tracking. Temporal fields ensure auditability. plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last update to notification record. For audit and delivery/debug tracking.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

Used by system to dynamically route and schedule notifications in line with user wishes and regulatory requirements (unsubscribe/tracking/audit). Audit fields allow compliance with privacy, legal, and policy changes, as well as support for re-consenting and change tracking.

foreignFields.name: political_economic_board_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member whose preference this record represents {@link political_economic_board_members.id}

plainFields.name: notification_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of notification governed (e.g., post_reply, admin_announcement, compliance_notice).

plainFields.name: delivery_channel

plainFields.name: custom_threshold

plainFields.name: last_changed_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: political_economic_board_event_logs

foreignFields.name: actor_member_id

foreignFields.name: actor_moderator_id

foreignFields.name: actor_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Acting administrator's {@link political_economic_board_administrators.id} when event originates from an admin.

plainFields.name: event_type
plainFields.description: Type/category of event (e.g., post_created, comment_deleted, login_attempt, moderation_action, system_error). Enables filtering and aggregation.

plainFields.name: target_object_type
plainFields.description: Entity type the event refers to (e.g., post, comment, profile, api, system); supports analytics on activity by object kind.

plainFields.name: target_object_id
plainFields.description: String identifier for the object targeted by this event (UUID, DB id, or external ref); used for tracing affected domain record.

plainFields.name: event_message

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update time of the event record (rarely modified except for error correction or audit trail).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion marker; null if record is active. Used for retention and legal hold.

models.name: political_economic_board_metrics
models.description: Stores aggregated or point-in-time analytics metrics (e.g., MAU, DAU, post_counts, report_counts, median_moderation_time) supporting platform health dashboards, KPI tracking, and business analysis. Each metric is associated with a name, value, window, and time granularity. Key for longitudinal studies, performance reporting, and business success evaluation. Metrics should be filtered and aggregated by name, window, and time. Referential integrity with period-specific owners is possible via nullable foreign keys.

foreignFields.name: owner_member_id
foreignFields.description: Metric calculated for a specific member's {@link political_economic_board_members.id} actions, if applicable (e.g., user retention, activity rates).

foreignFields.name: owner_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Metric calculated for a specific moderator's {@link political_economic_board_moderators.id} performance or behavior.

foreignFields.name: owner_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Metric tied to an admin's {@link political_economic_board_administrators.id} period (for admin-related analytics).

plainFields.name: metric_name
plainFields.description: Business label for the metric (e.g., 'dau', 'mau', 'median_mod_time', 'posts_today', 'post_quality_score'). Used in dashboards and analytics.

plainFields.name: metric_value
plainFields.description: Value of the metric; semantic depends on name but always represents a quantitative measurement available for statistics/KPI reporting.

plainFields.name: window_start

plainFields.description: Resolution of the metric (daily, weekly, monthly, real_time, etc.); used for aggregation/rollup in dashboards. Strongly affects analytics queries.

plainFields.name: notes

plainFields.name: created_at

plainFields.name: updated_at

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker for expired/obsolete metrics (retained for audit and rollback).

models.name: political_economic_board_data_anomalies
models.description: Tracks analytics, engagement, or system anomalies that may signal data quality issues, security events, business process exceptions, or unexpected user/system behavior. Used for business incident triage, process improvement, and compliance monitoring. Supports triage, investigation, assignment, and resolution tracking for all anomaly entries. Supports full-text search for anomaly type, description, and context information.

foreignFields.name: detected_by_member_id
foreignFields.description: User (member) {@link political_economic_board_members.id} who reported or detected the anomaly, if applicable.

foreignFields.name: detected_by_moderator_id
foreignFields.description: Moderator {@link political_economic_board_moderators.id} who reported the anomaly.

foreignFields.name: detected_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin {@link political_economic_board_administrators.id} who flagged or confirmed the anomaly.

plainFields.name: anomaly_type
plainFields.description: Category of anomaly (e.g., data_inconsistency, metrics_spike, missing_event, moderation_delay, duplicate_action, kpi_drop, suspicious_activity, integration_failure). Supports reporting and filtering.

plainFields.name: anomaly_status
plainFields.description: Current resolution state (open, in_progress, resolved, false_positive, ignored); business process triage status for workflow.

plainFields.description: Human-readable description of anomaly context, impact, and known data. Supports dashboarding, audit, search, and recall.

plainFields.description: Last time this anomaly or its status/notes changed; used for monitoring and compliance.

plainFields.name: deleted_at

models.name: political_economic_board_moderation_provider_logs
models.description: Stores detailed logs of all interactions and payloads exchanged with third-party content moderation providers for auditing, monitoring, and compliance within the politicalEconomicBoard platform. foreignFields.description: Reference to the dispatched notification's {@link political_economic_board_notifications.id}.

Timely and well-indexed for troubleshooting and governance. Generic enough to accommodate new API integrations without schema change.

}

### `political_economic_board_categories`

Master list of discussion board categories. Governs allowable top-level
topics for posts. Referenced by posts and visible to all user roles.
Category codes and names must be unique and changes are rare, supporting
stable system-wide topic organization.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Unique category code used by internal systems and APIs. Immutable for
  > reference integrity.
- `name`
  > Display name for the category (e.g., 'Politics', 'Economics'). Used in UI
  > and filters.
- `description`
  > Detailed category description for moderators and admins. Aids in content
  > and category management.
- `sort_order`: Relative sort order for displaying categories. Lower values appear first.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when category was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when category was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp. Null if active, set when logically deleted.

### `political_economic_board_tags`

Approved tag vocabulary for labeling posts. Tags improve search,
filtering, and content organization. Managed by admins to ensure
consistency and prevent spam. Tag names must be unique, and tags may be
disabled rather than deleted to maintain history integrity.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `name`: Unique tag text used for post labeling, discovery, and search.
- `description`
  > Human-oriented explanation of what content this tag should label. Shown
  > in tag selectors, hover, admin panels.
- `enabled`
  > Whether this tag can be assigned to new posts. Used to disable tags
  > without deleting historical references.
- `sort_order`: Order for admin/UIs to present tags. Lower values show first.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when tag was added.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when tag details were last modified.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp. Null if active, else set when logically deleted.

### `political_economic_board_settings`

Centralized storage for system-wide configuration. Stores arbitrary
business key/value/description records adjusted by admins at runtime.
Each key must be unique and contains an optional description, supporting
runtime audit and configuration versioning. Used for all persistent
system parameters not requiring dedicated tables.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `key`
  > Unique configuration option key. Used for programmatic lookups and
  > application behavior toggles.
- `value`
  > Raw configuration value or JSON block, depending on setting. Contains
  > current setting used by applications and services.
- `description`: Human-readable explanation of option, for admin panels and audit logs.
- `created_at`: Timestamp option was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp option was last changed.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp. Null means active. Config marked deleted is never
  > used at runtime.

### `political_economic_board_audit_logs`

Immutable log of significant system, admin, and configuration changes.
Each record documents a user action, system event, or data mutation
requiring permanent traceability for compliance, regulatory, or security
purposes. Audit logs support platform transparency, trust, and legal
review.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `event_type`
  > Business category of audit event (e.g., 'role_change', 'settings_update',
  > 'user_action'). Enables filtering and reporting on log categories.
- `actor_id`
  > Who performed the action/event. May reference any user/admin. For data
  > minimization, this field may be kept even if user deleted.
- `target_type`
  > Type of object affected by the event (e.g., 'member', 'post',
  > 'settings'). Enables multi-entity audits.
- `target_id`
  > ID of the affected object/entity (may reference various tables depending
  > on event_type). Required for cross-entity auditing.
- `description`
  > Detailed, human-friendly summary of event, for transparency and legal
  > review.
- `metadata`
  > Arbitrary extra data, typically in JSON string if relevant. Enables
  > extensibility of audit record without schema change.
- `created_at`: Timestamp log was created (immutable after insert).

### `political_economic_board_guests`

Represents guest users visiting politicalEconomicBoard. Used to track
anonymous access, metadata (such as browser, device, IP), temporary
tokens for guest sessions, and rate-limiting behavior. Guests may
transition to registered members upon sign-up. No business actions are
permitted for this role. Relationships: None direct. Serves as a
reference for anonymous activity and system operation statistics.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `session_token`: Unique browser/session token to track guest anonymously.
- `ip_address`: Last known IP address of the guest user.
- `user_agent`: User agent string (browser/device) of the guest.
- `created_at`: Timestamp for guest session creation.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last guest session update.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for guest session, if terminated.

### `political_economic_board_members`

Stores all registered members with verified accounts on the platform.
Contains identity and basic contact/authentication info, verification and
registration metadata (excluding profile, which is in separate table).
Members can be upgraded to moderators or administrators (with reference
to role change logs).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `email`: Email address for login/verification (must be unique).
- `hashed_password`: Password hash for authentication purposes.
- `is_email_verified`: Whether the email address is verified.
- `last_login_at`: Timestamp of most recent member login.
- `registration_ip`: IP address during member registration.
- `created_at`: Timestamp the member joined the platform.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp of last member data update.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp if member deletes/leaves platform.

### `political_economic_board_moderators`

Elevated user accounts with moderation privileges. Linked to members
(one-to-one, as only members may be promoted). Maintains
activation/deactivation timestamps, moderator notes, and event status.
Permanent audit trail required for promotion/demotion actions (see
political_economic_board_role_changes).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`: Belonged member's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members).
- `activated_at`: Timestamp moderator privileges were granted.
- `deactivated_at`: Timestamp moderator role revoked or expired, if applicable.
- `moderator_notes`: Freeform notes on moderation appointment, limits, or context.
- `created_at`: Timestamp moderator record was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp moderator record last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp for former moderator accounts.

### `political_economic_board_administrators`

Highest privilege user accounts for site governance, role assignments,
escalations, and config changes. Linked to members (one-to-one, as only
members may be promoted). Full auditability and clear role separation are
essential. Distinguished from moderators by administrator status/level.
Action history recorded separately (see
political_economic_board_role_changes and logs).

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`: Belonged member's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members).
- `activated_at`: Timestamp administrator privileges were granted.
- `deactivated_at`: Timestamp administrator role revoked or expired, if applicable.
- `admin_notes`: Administrative comments or rationale for specific privileges, if any.
- `created_at`: Timestamp administrator record created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp administrator record updated.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft delete timestamp for administrator account (if downgraded or
  > deleted).

### `political_economic_board_auth_sessions`

Tracks all authenticated user sessions for members, moderators, and
administrators. Includes JWT/refresh tokens, device info, session expiry,
IP, and audit. Used for security, MFA, and suspicious activity detection.
Each row represents one authentication session; session ending triggers
record update to reflect closure.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`: Session's owner member [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members).
- `session_token`
  > JWT/access token for current session (opaque storage, not user
  > credentials).
- `refresh_token`: Refresh token for session lifecycle management.
- `device_info`: Details on device/browser used in the session.
- `ip_address`: IP address associated with this session.
- `session_expires_at`: Expiration timestamp for session token.
- `revoked_at`: Timestamp when session was terminated/revoked, if any.
- `created_at`: Timestamp session created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp session last updated or extended.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete for session history retention, if expired/terminated.

### `political_economic_board_verification_tokens`

Email verification and secondary auth challenge table. Each token is
unique, time-bound, and belongs to a member. Supports registration
verification, password resets, and email challenge flows for MFA. Tokens
record purpose, target, and creation/expiry audit fields.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Verification token's owner member {@link
  > political_economic_board_members.id}.
- `token`: Opaque random string representing the verification token value.
- `token_type`: Purpose of token: e.g., email_verification, reset_password, mfa.
- `context`
  > Additional context for this token, e.g., origin email, device, or request
  > meta.
- `expires_at`: Timestamp after which token is invalid.
- `used_at`: Timestamp when the token was used (if applicable).
- `created_at`: Timestamp when token was generated.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp last updated (e.g., reissued/rotated).
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete if token invalidated or removed before expiry.

### `political_economic_board_password_resets`

Manages all password reset flows and history. Stores reset tokens,
request/fulfillment audit data, and intent context. Token must be unique
per reset. Used by backend flows for secure user-initiated password
changes and automated lockout recovery. Security: sensitive context must
be purged after fulfillment or expiry.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Owner member who initiated password reset {@link
  > political_economic_board_members.id}.
- `reset_token`: Random unique token for password reset authentication.
- `request_ip`: IP address from which reset was requested.
- `fulfilled_at`: Timestamp request was completed (password was changed).
- `expires_at`: Timestamp reset token becomes invalid.
- `created_at`: Timestamp reset request created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp reset record last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete timestamp, if record removed.

### `political_economic_board_role_changes`

Audit table for all user role changes: log upgrades, demotions,
suspensions, reactivations, with rationale and actor chain. Each event
references a member, previous and new role, trigger origin
(admin/mod/system), and event context. This is the authoritative ledger
for permissions history and compliance tracing. Immutable except for soft
delete. Used for platform audits and compliance, but never modifies role
status; that is managed by role-specific tables.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Target member for this role change log entry {@link
  > political_economic_board_members.id}.
- `old_role`: Previous role before change (guest, member, moderator, administrator).
- `new_role`: New role after change (same value set as old_role).
- `context`
  > Freeform context for the change: reason, policy citation, compliance
  > reference, etc.
- `triggered_by_actor_type`: Type of actor who initiated change (system, moderator, administrator).
- `triggered_by_actor_id`: Actor's ID (admin/mod/system id) responsible for change.
- `change_reason`: Rationale or justification provided by triggering actor.
- `created_at`: Timestamp role change was logged.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp role change record last updated (for audit sync).
- `deleted_at`: Soft delete audit for compliance (never physical delete).

### `political_economic_board_profiles`

Stores public profile data for each member, distinct from authentication
or role tables. Includes display name, bio, profile photo, join date, and
privacy settings. Each profile is linked to a single member entity in
political_economic_board_members, and may have multiple associated badges
and statistics. Designed for frequent updates and privacy-driven data
management.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Linked member entity's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members).
  > One-to-one relationship, ensures every profile belongs to one member.
- `display_name`
  > Public name visible to other users. 1-50 characters, must be unique
  > across active profiles.
- `bio`: Profile biography or summary, up to 500 characters. Optional.
- `profile_photo_url`: URL to uploaded profile photo (JPG/PNG, max 2MB). Optional.
- `join_date`
  > Date profile was first created or linked to a member. For analytics and
  > display.
- `privacy_level`
  > Profile privacy setting (e.g., 'public', 'members_only', 'private').
  > Business logic in API layer enforces allowed values.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when profile was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when profile was last updated (any non-deleted field).
- `deleted_at`: Nullable timestamp for soft deletes.

### `political_economic_board_profile_badges`

Tracks awarded badges or achievements to individual profiles,
representing user reputation, contributions, or recognition (e.g.,
'founding member', 'top contributor'). Multiple badges can be assigned
per profile, each with type, issue date, optional expiration, and unique
badge code per profile. Enables flexible badge expansion and business
logic enforcement on award frequency and scope.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_profile_id`
  > Target profile's [political_economic_board_profiles.id](#political_economic_board_profiles) receiving
  > this badge.
- `badge_code`
  > Unique code or slug representing badge type. E.g., 'founding_member',
  > 'top_contributor'.
- `title`: Display title for badge ('Founding Member', etc.).
- `description`: Longer description of the badge's meaning or achievement. Optional.
- `issued_at`: Timestamp when badge was granted to the profile.
- `expires_at`: Nullable timestamp for expiration for time-limited awards.
- `created_at`: Timestamp row was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp for last badge update.

### `political_economic_board_profile_stats`

Maintains aggregate, de-identified activity metrics for each profile
(posts, comments, votes, reactions, earned badges, and reputation score).
Allows fast retrieval of user stats and supports periodic recalculation
by business logic. Data is aggregate, not individual events, and can be
reset or recalculated. Profile stats are used in profile displays,
leaderboards, and eligibility checks for advanced features or moderation.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_profile_id`
  > Profile being summarized. Foreign key to {@link
  > political_economic_board_profiles.id}.
- `posts_count`: Total number of non-deleted posts authored by this profile.
- `comments_count`: Total number of comments authored by this profile.
- `votes_cast_count`: Total number of upvotes/downvotes cast by this user.
- `reactions_cast_count`: Total number of emoji reactions performed by this user.
- `badges_earned_count`: Current unique badges awarded to this profile.
- `reputation_score`: Current reputation tally, according to voting/achievement rules.
- `last_calculated_at`: Timestamp stats were last updated or recalculated to reflect new activity.
- `created_at`: Row creation timestamp.
- `updated_at`: Row update timestamp.

### `political_economic_board_profile_changes`

Stores snapshots and audit logs of all profile changes (display name,
bio, privacy, etc.), providing a temporal historical record for
transparency, rollback, and compliance. Each row reflects an individual
change event, referencing the affected profile and authoring user, with
field changed, old and new values, timestamp, and rationale. Allows
administrators or audit tools to reconstruct profile history and support
dispute resolution or compliance requirements.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_profile_id`: Profile changed. References [political_economic_board_profiles.id](#political_economic_board_profiles).
- `change_author_member_id`
  > Account responsible for this profile change. {@link
  > political_economic_board_members.id}.
- `change_field`: The profile field updated (e.g., 'display_name', 'bio', 'privacy_level').
- `old_value`
  > Previous value before change occurred, for audit trail. Optional (may be
  > null if no previous value).
- `new_value`: New value after the update. Optional, may be null for deletions.
- `change_reason`
  > Reason or justification for the profile change. May be entered by user or
  > generated by system.
- `changed_at`: Timestamp of when this change was processed/applied.

### `political_economic_board_posts`

Represents the main discussion post entities on the platform. Each record
captures an authored post including title, body, category, and submitter.
Enforces business rules for content quota, policy validation, and links
to related content such as categories and tags. Lifecycle fields
(created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) and author relationships support
moderation, edit, and audit requirements. All foreign keys refer to
already existing reference/user tables.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `author_member_id`
  > Belonged member's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members). References
  > the post author (member user account).
- `category_id`
  > Belonged category's [political_economic_board_categories.id](#political_economic_board_categories). Links
  > to the platform-defined topic category.
- `title`
  > Post title. Must be between 10 and 100 characters, validated per business
  > rule. Used for thread indexing and search.
- `body`
  > Full content of the post. Range: 50–10,000 characters. Subject to
  > policy/prohibited content screening algorithms. Indexed for search.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when the post was created.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when the post was last updated (edited).
- `deleted_at`
  > Timestamp marking when the post was soft-deleted (if applicable); null if
  > not deleted. Supports audit, retention policies, and restore.

### `political_economic_board_post_histories`

Snapshot/audit table recording every significant change to the main post.
Preserves all relevant fields as they were at the time of modification,
including author, title, body, and status for full edit/replay/audit
trail. Enables moderation rollback, author dispute resolution, and
supports content lifecycle legal/compliance requirements. No recalculated
or derived fields; snapshot only captures raw state at change moment.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`
  > Target post's [political_economic_board_posts.id](#political_economic_board_posts). Connects
  > snapshot to the corresponding main post record.
- `editor_member_id`
  > Editing member's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members). Captures
  > the identity of the user who performed the change (could be original
  > author or moderator/admin).
- `title`
  > Title at the time of snapshot. Enables historical trace of changes for
  > audit, dispute resolution, or legal recovery.
- `body`
  > Post body content at the time of snapshot. Supports full rollback or
  > display of previous edits.
- `status`
  > Short code or description of the post's moderation/workflow state at the
  > point of snapshot (e.g., 'published', 'pending', 'hidden').
- `edited_at`
  > Timestamp when the snapshot/edit occurred. Indicates the moment this
  > state became active.
- `change_reason`
  > (Optional) Reason or comment describing why the change was made, as
  > entered by the editor or generated by moderator workflow. Useful for
  > audit/compliance.

### `political_economic_board_post_statuses`

Represents the status and workflow stage of each post for moderation,
publication, reporting, or legal archiving. Tracks current and historical
state assignments (e.g., pending, published, hidden, under_review), who
applied them, and when. This enables independent moderation, content
lifecycle management, reporting, and rapid compliance workflows. No
denormalized or recalculated data.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `post_id`
  > Target post's [political_economic_board_posts.id](#political_economic_board_posts). Links this
  > status to its post.
- `set_by_member_id`
  > Member or moderator's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members) who set
  > the status. Identifies who performed the workflow action.
- `status`
  > Short code or workflow status for the post (e.g., 'pending', 'published',
  > 'hidden', 'under_review'). Used to drive business state logic and
  > moderation workflows.
- `set_at`: Timestamp when this status assignment occurred.
- `reason`
  > (Optional) Reason for the status change. Used to provide rationale to
  > moderators, authors, or audit/compliance review.
- `expired_at`
  > (Optional) Scheduled expiry time for the status, if state is meant to
  > revert or timeout (e.g., temporary bans, scheduled publications).

### `political_economic_board_comments`

Business entity for platform comments attached to posts. Supports
hierarchical (nested) threading up to three levels, relates to posts and
members, supports moderation, reaction, and voting via external reference
tables. Core for discussions, enforcing per-user quotas, edit/delete time
windows, content validation, and audit requirements. Maintains relations
to current status and preserves key time/event metadata. Native UUID
enforced for distributed safety.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_post_id`
  > Parent post's [political_economic_board_posts.id](#political_economic_board_posts). Required for
  > comment association with main discussion thread.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Authoring member's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members).
  > Identifies the creator of the comment. Required for audit and voting.
- `parent_id`
  > Parent comment's [political_economic_board_comments.id](#political_economic_board_comments), if this is
  > a reply (nested). Null for top-level comments.
- `current_status_id`
  > Current status from [political_economic_board_comment_statuses.id](#political_economic_board_comment_statuses),
  > indicating the lifecycle state (active, edited, deleted, pending, hidden,
  > etc.).
- `body`
  > Main comment body text. Required 5-1,000 chars, validated by business
  > rules. Subject to moderation and full-text search.
- `nesting_level`
  > Indicates depth in nested structure (0 for root, 1 for first reply, max 2
  > for third level). Used to enforce max nesting and optimize queries.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when comment is created. Used for ordering and business audit.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp for last edit/update to comment. Used for tracking changes and
  > edit limits.
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft-delete timestamp for logical removal, retained for retention period
  > per audit requirements. Null unless removed.

### `political_economic_board_comment_histories`

Audit entity capturing every historical state/change of a comment.
Snapshots each version of the comment's body, status, and key
relationships, linked to root comment and responsible member. Provides
rollback and restoration points for moderation, dispute, and compliance
audit. Required for investigation and full edit/removal traceability.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_comment_id`
  > Root comment's [political_economic_board_comments.id](#political_economic_board_comments). Historical
  > snapshot parent.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Member id responsible for change (editor, author, moderator, admin,
  > etc.). See [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members).
- `status_id`
  > Status at the time of change, from {@link
  > political_economic_board_comment_statuses.id}. Historical lifecycle
  > status for this revision.
- `body`
  > Snapshot of the comment's body at this revision. Required, 5-1,000 chars.
  > Immutable historical value.
- `change_reason`
  > Reason for the change/edit, required for moderator/admin actions (e.g.,
  > 'moderation correction', 'user edit', 'auto-hide', etc.).
- `created_at`
  > When this historical revision is created (i.e., when the edit, deletion,

### `political_economic_board_comment_statuses`

Normalized code/label/status table for all possible comment lifecycle
states. Used by comments and comment_histories for flexible, auditable
state transitions (e.g., ACTIVE, EDITED, DELETED, HIDDEN,
PENDING_MODERATION, etc.). Enables code-driven workflows, consistent
labeling, and business rules for allowable transitions.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `code`
  > Machine code/enum for status (e.g., 'ACTIVE', 'EDITED', etc.). Unique per
  > row, not user facing. Used in business logic and APIs.
- `label`
  > User-displayable label for the comment status (e.g., 'Active', 'Edited',
  > 'Deleted'). Used for display, notification, and UI mapping.
- `description`
  > Detailed explanation of the status code, describing business rules,
  > moderation action, or visibility impacts.
- `order`
  > Sort order for UI/status sequencing. Lower numbers appear first in lists.
  > Used for presentation sorting.
- `created_at`: Time when status entry was created (for audit). Immutable after creation.
- `updated_at`: Time when last updated (for UI or business rule changes).

### `political_economic_board_reports`

Stores all user/member-initiated reports on posts or comments in the
politicalEconomicBoard. This model captures the reporting user's
identity, content reference (post or comment), report reason code,
explanatory description, and status info (open, under_review, resolved,
escalated). Each report acts as the origin point for moderation queueing
and subsequent review. Relations include referencing the reporter ({@link
political_economic_board_members.id}), the target content ({@link
political_economic_board_posts.id} or {@link
political_economic_board_comments.id}), and audit trail. Used as a
canonical source of evidence for all moderation and appeal workflows.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `reporter_id`
  > Reporting member's unique identifier. {@link
  > political_economic_board_members.id}
- `target_post_id`
  > Target post's identifier if the report concerns a post. {@link
  > political_economic_board_posts.id}
- `target_comment_id`
  > Target comment's identifier if the report concerns a comment. {@link
  > political_economic_board_comments.id}
- `reason_code`
  > Coded reason for the report (e.g., hate_speech, misinformation, spam,
  > harassment, off_topic). Defined by fixed business list for moderation
  > reporting and audit compliance.
- `description`
  > Additional member-provided description or justification for the report.
  > Optional field for audit or moderator context.
- `status`
  > Current lifecycle state of the report (open, under_review, resolved,
  > escalated, closed, etc.) for workflow management and SLA compliance.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when report was created. For audit and operational SLA purposes.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of last update (status change, escalation, moderator note,
  > etc.).
- `deleted_at`
  > Soft-delete timestamp if report was removed/canceled (retained for audit
  > purposes).

### `political_economic_board_moderation_queue`

Tracks reports and content items actively queued for moderator review in
politicalEconomicBoard. This model links each entry to the originating
report ([political_economic_board_reports.id](#political_economic_board_reports)), and the content
item under review. It stores moderation status (pending, in_progress,
escalated, decided), priority level, scheduled review timestamps, and
meta relevant for queue dashboards. Ensures that no report remains
unassigned and supports audit visibility for queue handling SLAs.

  > Current state: pending, in_progress, escalated, resolved, closed. Used

- `priority`: Priority of the item in moderation queue (higher = more urgent).
- `scheduled_review_at`: When this item is scheduled for moderator attention.
- `decided_at`: When final moderation action was taken. Null if undecided.
- `created_at`: Timestamp when queue entry was created.
- `updated_at`: Last status change or moderator comment on this queue item.

### `political_economic_board_moderator_actions`

Captures each moderator's actions/interventions with relation to reports
and flagged content in politicalEconomicBoard. This model provides a full
audit log: which moderator took which action (edit, delete, approve,
restrict, escalate) on which report/content, the rationale, and resultant
status changes. Used for regulatory compliance, accountability, and
monitoring action throughput. References both the acting moderator and
the report/content affected.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `moderator_id`
  > Performing moderator's identifier. {@link
  > political_economic_board_moderators.id}
- `report_id`

- `action_type`

- `old_status`: Previous status before this action (pre-moderation).

- `created_at`: Timestamp of the moderator action.

politicalEconomicBoard. Each appeal references the relevant report,

### `political_economic_board_notifications`

Stores all per-user, system, and operational notifications generated for
members. Each notification record captures delivery channel, notification
type, status, scheduling, and all business/audit details. Core
relationships include recipient's {@link
political_economic_board_members.id} and (if triggered by system event)
entity references such as post ID or comment ID. Fields capture both
delivery constraints (scheduled vs sent), status (pending, delivered,
failed), and support for retries or escalation tracking. Temporal fields
ensure auditability. GIN index on subject and message allow fast fuzzy
text search for notification retrieval, especially for in-app alerts.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`: Recipient member's [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members)
- `notification_type`
  > Type/category of notification (e.g., post_reply, comment_mention,
  > report_outcome, system_announcement). Used to filter and drive user
  > preferences, delivery logic, and audit.
- `delivery_channel`
  > Channel over which the notification was/will be delivered (e.g., in_app,
  > email, sms, push). Drives delivery logic and supports user/channel opt-in
  > tracking.
- `subject`
  > Notification subject or summary, usually displayed in app notification
  > list or as email subject. Optimized for search/display purposes.
- `message`
  > Notification body/message or content delivered to user. Can contain
  > markdown or rich text; full content required for audits and display.
- `status`
  > Current delivery status (e.g., pending, sent, delivered, failed, read).
  > Used for efficient querying, delivery retries, and read/unread tracking.
- `scheduled_at`
  > Optional scheduled send time. Null means notification was delivered
  > immediately, otherwise queued or delayed to this timestamp.
- `sent_at`
  > Timestamp when notification was successfully sent/delivered via the
  > chosen channel.
- `read_at`
  > Timestamp when user read the notification (null = unread). Used for
  > in-app unread count and notification badge logic.
- `retry_count`
  > Number of times delivery of notification has been retried or attempted,
  > for failed/pending only. Supports delivery audit and automated
  > escalation.
- `failure_reason`
  > Detailed error message or failure reason for undelivered notifications
  > (null if never failed). Supports audit trail, root-cause analysis.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp when notification was created. For audit and chronological
  > ordering.
- `updated_at`
  > Timestamp of the last update to notification record. For audit and
  > delivery/debug tracking.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp for audit/retention flows. Null if not deleted.

### `political_economic_board_notification_prefs`

Per-member notification preferences, controlling opt-in/opt-out status,
channel preferences, and fine-grained controls for each notification
type. Each record specifies delivery channel (e.g., email, in_app, sms,
push), type, and user's chosen state (enabled/disabled, custom
threshold). Tied to [political_economic_board_members.id](#political_economic_board_members). Used by
system to dynamically route and schedule notifications in line with user
wishes and regulatory requirements (unsubscribe/tracking/audit). Audit
fields allow compliance with privacy, legal, and policy changes, as well
as support for re-consenting and change tracking.

Properties as follows:

- `id`: Primary Key.
- `political_economic_board_member_id`
  > Member whose preference this record represents {@link
  > political_economic_board_members.id}
- `notification_type`
  > Type/category of notification governed (e.g., post_reply,
  > admin_announcement, compliance_notice).
- `delivery_channel`
  > Notification channel (email, in_app, sms, push) for which the preference
  > applies.
- `enabled`
  > Whether this notification (by type/channel) is enabled for delivery.
  > False records opt-out for this combination.
- `custom_threshold`
  > Custom threshold—minimum event count or notification batching—before user
  > wants to be notified. Null means immediate/as generated. Supports
  > digest/daily summary.
- `last_changed_at`
  > Timestamp of the latest change for this preference record. Supports audit
  > trail and compliance re-consent flows.
- `created_at`
  > Timestamp this preference record was created. For full preference
  > history/audit.
- `updated_at`: Timestamp when this record was last updated.
- `deleted_at`: Soft-delete timestamp for retention/rollback. Null if not deleted.

### `political_economic_board_event_logs`

Records all significant actions, events, and system occurrences for the
platform including user activity, moderation steps, system events, and
error states. Serves as a source of truth for audit, health monitoring,
and analytics. Supports filtering by type, subject, actor, or system
area. Events can originate from users, automated systems, or
integrations. Supports flexible payload for forward-compatibility. Strong
indexation for time-based and type-based queries. Full-text search
enabled for event_message.

  > Type/category of event (e.g., post_created, comment_deleted,

  > aggregation.
